summary: Issue 18 done: added GET /api/log serving ANSI-stripped byte ranges of an attempt's raw log (offset, nextOffset, totalSize, attempts list incl. rotated older attempts and resolvers), the events endpoint now also returns the ticket's spec text, and the ticket Detail renders a raw log pane below the timeline with clickable attempt rows; a never-run ticket shows its spec text with a no-attempts marker. Server tests cover range reads, ANSI stripping, chunk paging, UTF-8 boundary safety, and the attempt list; projection tests cover attempt selection and the never-run fallback. 177 engine + 68 UI tests, both typechecks, and the build pass.
